description:
Create is a physics puzzle sandbox where Archipelago controls world access and object ownership.
The Dolphin client reads challenge Sparks and Create Chains from RAM, then enforces received AP items live.

create_v0.1.0.description:
Initial release of the *Create* Archipelago.

This release adds *Create* as a playable Archipelago world with:

- Support for all main Worlds
- Optional support for the II Worlds
- Random or selected Starting World
- Random or selected Goal World
- World unlocks
- Object unlocks
- Universal Tracker support, including known alternative solutions as glitched possibilities

...and much more (see the full list in [Create Game Info](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/blob/Create-AP/worlds/create/docs/en_Create.md)).

Requires Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer, Dolphin Emulator, and the **PAL** Wii version of *Create* (`SECP69`).

The APWorld uses an external **Create Client** which connects to Dolphin through Dolphin Memory Engine.
**Save Slot 3 is required**, and using a fresh save for every new seed is strongly recommended.

See the [Setup Guide](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/blob/Create-AP/worlds/create/docs/setup_en.md) for installation and setup instructions.

I've tested the APWorld extensively and it should be ready for Archipelago sessions with your friends. Since this is the initial release, however, there may still be smaller issues or edge cases that I haven't encountered during testing.

If you find any bugs or have suggestions for the APWorld, make sure to join the official Archipelago Discord server and let me know in the **Create (Wii)** thread under **Future Game Design**.
